steps.title: Deparaffinize tissue (or alcohol prep)
steps.instruction: Place the tissue in a 1.5 ml or 2 ml microcentrifuge tube. Add 300 µl Deparaffinization Solution, vortex vigorously for 10 s, and briefly centrifuge to collect the sample at the tube bottom. For specimens stored only in alcohol (not paraffin‑fixed), skip this step; instead add 300 µl ATL, 300 µl AL, and 300 µl ethanol (96–100%) and proceed directly to step 3, omitting the incubation step.

steps.title: Incubate at 56 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube at 56 °C for 3 min, then allow it to cool to room temperature.

steps.title: Add Buffer FTB and Proteinase K
steps.instruction: Add 25 µl Buffer FTB, 55 µl RNase‑free water, and 20 µl Proteinase K; vortex to mix, then briefly centrifuge to collect any material adhering to the tube walls or cap.

steps.title: Separate aqueous lysate
steps.instruction: Carefully remove and discard the upper blue phase. Keep the lower aqueous lysate, add 150 µl RNase‑free water, and vortex. If the deparaffinization step was omitted, remove 900 µl of the upper lysate instead.

steps.title: Add RNase A
steps.instruction: Add 2 µl RNase A, vortex, and incubate at room temperature on the bench for 2 min.

steps.title: Proteinase K digestion
steps.instruction: Add 20 µl Proteinase K, vortex, then incubate at 65 °C for 15 min while shaking at 450 rpm.

steps.title: Add Buffer AL and ethanol
steps.instruction: Add 250 µl Buffer AL and 250 µl ethanol (96–100%) to the sample; mix thoroughly by vortexing.

steps.title: Load lysate onto column (first load)
steps.instruction: Transfer 450 µl lysate to a QIAamp UCP MinElute column placed in a 2 ml collection tube; centrifuge at 15,000 rpm for 30 s (maximum speed recommended).

steps.title: Load remaining lysate
steps.instruction: Transfer the residual lysate to the same column; centrifuge at 15,000 rpm for 1 min. Discard the flow‑through from steps 10 and 11 and reuse the collection tube (maximum speed recommended).

steps.title: Wash with Buffer AW1
steps.instruction: Add 500 µl Buffer AW1 to the spin column; centrifuge at 15,000 rpm for 30 s; discard the flow‑through and reuse the collection tube.

steps.title: Wash with Buffer AW2
steps.instruction: Add 500 µl Buffer AW2 to the spin column; centrifuge at 15,000 rpm for 30 s; discard the flow‑through and reuse the collection tube.

steps.title: Elution buffer addition
steps.instruction: Place the QIAamp UCP MinElute column into a clean 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube, discard the previous collection tube, open the column lid and apply 20 µl Buffer ATE to the center of the membrane.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Close the lid, incubate at room temperature for 1 min, then centrifuge at full speed for 1 min to elute DNA. Repeat this elution two additional times (total three elutions) to obtain a final volume of 60 µl (20 µl × 3). Note: final volume may be up to 100 µl; 60 µl gave the most successful results.

steps.title: Incubate DNA at 56 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the eluate for 2 h at 56 °C while shaking at 1000 rpm. Note: more than 1 h is generally required; >2 h gave the most successful results, and older samples may be incubated overnight.

steps.title: Incubate DNA at 90 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the sample for 1 h at 90 °C without shaking.
